claim: With an AWS Business Support+, AWS Enterprise Support or AWS Unified Operations plan you can use the AWS Health API. In an AWS Region that doesn't offer one of these plans, or if you haven't transitioned to one of them, you can use the AWS Health API with a Business, Enterprise On-Ramp or Enterprise Support plan. The AWS Health Dashboard is available for all AWS customers at no additional cost.

values.display: you can use the AWS Health API

qualifiers.condition: The older plans apply in Regions without the new plans or before you transition; the AWS Health Dashboard needs no support plan.

evidence.quote: If you have an AWS Business Support\+, AWS Enterprise Support, or AWS Unified Operations plan, you can use the AWS Health API to integrate with in-house and third-party systems.

If you're in an AWS Region that doesn't offer one of these AWS Support plans, or if you haven't transitioned to one of these plans, you can use the AWS Health API with a Business, Enterprise On-Ramp, or Enterprise Support plan.
The AWS Health Dashboard is available for all AWS customers at no additional cost.
